- region: ERCO (ERCOT)
- horizon: 60 minutes (one-hour)
- cost_shortfall: 10.0
- cost_reserve: 1.0
- rolling design: train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, rolling_step_days=30

This is an accept. Let me build the JSON.

admissible_variables: array containing only allowed ones. I'll include the relevant ones. So I can include a subset. Let me include all admissible ones that are relevant. Actually it says "containing only" those - meaning only from that list. I'll include a reasonable set.

numerical_output_policy: computed_by_verified_workflow_only

explanation: state numerical outputs produced by verified workflow.

- audit_and_human_approval
